reason: 単一LLMに複数personaを動的に演じさせてmulti-turn self-collaborationを行い、複雑taskのproblem-solving能力とhallucinationを改善するprompting/agent capability研究。主要評価はTrivia Creative Writing、Codenames、Logic Grid Puzzleのtask performanceで、agentic inference runtime・scheduling・memory・serving効率化を提案しない。
title: Unleashing the Emergent Cognitive Synergy in Large Language Models: A Task-Solving Agent through Multi-Persona Self-Collaboration
